parameters.query: INSERT INTO jobs (tenant_id, job_key, job_type, payload, max_attempts) VALUES ($1, $2, 'recovery', $3::jsonb, 3) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, job_key) DO UPDATE SET job_key = jobs.job_key RETURNING id

WITH next AS (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE tenant_id = $2 AND job_key = $3 AND ((status IN ('queued','failed') AND run_after <= now()) OR (status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at < now()))  AND attempt_count < max_attempts FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', lease_owner = $1, lease_expires_at = now() + interval '60 seconds', attempt_count = j.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = now() FROM next WHERE j.id = next.id RETURNING j.id, j.tenant_id, j.job_key, j.attempt_count

WITH u AS (UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', result = $5::jsonb, attempt_count = $3::int, completed_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $4 AND status = 'running' RETURNING id, tenant_id) INSERT INTO job_attempts (job_id, tenant_id, attempt_no, worker_id, outcome, finished_at) SELECT id, tenant_id, $3::int, $4, 'completed', now() FROM u ON CONFLICT (job_id, attempt_no) DO NOTHING RETURNING job_id

parameters.query: WITH u AS (UPDATE jobs SET status = 'dead', attempt_count = $3::int, last_error = $5, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $4 AND status = 'running' RETURNING id, tenant_id), a AS (INSERT INTO job_attempts (job_id, tenant_id, attempt_no, worker_id, outcome, error, finished_at) SELECT id, tenant_id, $3::int, $4, 'dead', $5, now() FROM u ON CONFLICT (job_id, attempt_no) DO NOTHING) INSERT INTO notifications (tenant_id, job_id, reason) SELECT tenant_id, id, 'Job ' || $6::text || ' failed after 3 attempts and was dead-lettered: ' || $5 FROM u ON CONFLICT (job_id, reason) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

parameters.query: WITH dead AS (UPDATE jobs SET status = 'dead', last_error = COALESCE(last_error || ' | ', '') || 'recovery: attempts exhausted after lease expiry', lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE attempt_count >= max_attempts AND ((status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at < now()) OR status IN ('failed', 'queued')) RETURNING id, tenant_id), n AS (INSERT INTO notifications (tenant_id, job_id, reason) SELECT tenant_id, id, 'Job ' || id::text || ' dead-lettered by recovery: attempts exhausted' FROM dead ON CONFLICT (job_id, reason) DO NOTHING) SELECT j.tenant_id, j.job_key, j.payload, true AS recovery FROM jobs j JOIN tenants t ON t.id = j.tenant_id WHERE j.job_type = 'recovery' AND j.attempt_count < j.max_attempts AND ((j.status IN ('queued', 'failed') AND j.run_after <= now()) OR (j.status = 'running' AND j.lease_expires_at < now())) ORDER BY j.tenant_id, j.id LIMIT 25

UPDATE jobs SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_expires_at = now() + interval '60 seconds', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::bigint AND tenant_id = $2 AND lease_owner = $3 AND status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at > now() AND attempt_count < max_attempts RETURNING id
